title: Environment Reproducibility Auditor
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Judge whether each of six environment specifications rebuilds the same software on a second machine, and name the reason when it does not.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge whether each of 6 environment specifications rebuilds the same software on a second machine, and name the reason, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Specification 4 installs a package that imports without error. Describe the one-line check that would have exposed the problem.
commonMisconceptions: A file that lists packages is automatically reproducible.
A full export from one machine rebuilds on any machine.
A package that imports without error has the capabilities you need.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
